review_summary: Matches the bound warehouse-startup scene: a wide contemporary Korean warehouse shows first stored goods arriving, cartons and pallet-handling tools in active use, and mostly empty shelving that clearly conveys an early transitional operating stage. Small non-identifying workers, cool blue-gray natural light, restrained painterly realism, and ample environmental space support the requested quiet practical mood without invented violence, weapons, branding, legible identity text, or unsupported outcomes.
